title: 公告
content_zh:
【假日提醒】

    “满眼游丝兼落絮，红杏开时，一霎清明雨”， 三天的清明小长假来咯！

    在这个防疫的特殊时期，大家不论踏青祭扫，都要注意做好个人防护，避免人群聚集。

    更可以通过网络云赏景云祭扫等多种形式，文明绿色地度过清明假期哟~

    清明节假期算是非常重要的节日和节气，废个球决定在这三天假期中将多更一章给大家阅读，但不一定是这三天中的哪一天，嘿嘿!

    非常感谢各位球球粉对废个球的支持与鼓励

    在此祝各位清明节节日安康!

    《逆仙成魔传》公告 正在手打中，请稍等片刻，

    内容更新后，请重新刷新页面，即可获取最新更新！
content_en:
【Holiday Reminder】

    "My eyes are full of hairsprings and fallen catkins, and when the red apricots bloom, a Qingming rain comes for a moment." The three-day Qingming holiday is here!

    During this special period of epidemic prevention, everyone must pay attention to personal protection and avoid crowd gatherings, regardless of whether they are outing or visiting.

    You can also spend the Qingming Festival in a civilized and green manner through various forms such as online cloud viewing, cloud festivals and scanning.

    The Qingming Festival holiday is a very important festival and solar term. Fei Geqiu has decided to update an extra chapter for everyone to read during these three days of holiday, but it doesn’t have to be on which day of these three days, hehe!

    Thank you very much to all the fans of Qiuqiu for your support and encouragement to Feigeqiu.

    I wish you all a healthy Qingming Festival!

    Announcement of "The Legend of the Immortal and the Demon" is being downloaded, please wait a moment.

    After the content is updated, please refresh the page to get the latest updates!
